core.title: Fatigue Life Prediction of Ultrahigh Performance Concrete Using Gaussian Process Regression With SHAP Interpretation and Yeo–Johnson Transformation
core.venue: Fatigue & Fracture of Engineering Materials & Structures
core.abstract: ABSTRACT Accurate prediction of the fatigue life of ultrahigh performance concrete (UHPC), due to its complex multiparameter dependent nonlinear behavior, presents a major challenge for ensuring structural safety and durability. To address this issue, this study integrates machine learning algorithms with interpretability analysis to develop a high‐precision prediction model. The Yeo–Johnson transformation was employed to correct the pronounced positive skewness of the UHPC fatigue life data. Through a systematic evaluation of seven machine learning algorithms, the hyperparameter‐optimized Gaussian Process Regression model exhibited the best overall performance ( R 2 = 0.9931, MAPE = 1.410%). Validation against the source data further confirmed the robustness of Gaussian process regression (GPR) with an R 2 of 0.939, significantly outperforming the existing model ( R 2 = 0.665). Furthermore, Shapley Additive exPlanations analysis revealed that coarse aggregate volume, cube compressive strength, and stress level are the dominant influencing factors, accounting for over 85% of the prediction variability. Consequently, this research provides a robust engineering framework for the assessment of UHPC fatigue life.
core.summary: 本文针对超高性能混凝土疲劳寿命的多参数非线性预测问题，采用Yeo–Johnson变换处理数据正偏，并比较七种机器学习算法。摘要报告，调优后的高斯过程回归表现最佳，且在源数据验证中优于既有模型。SHAP分析进一步识别出粗骨料体积、立方体抗压强度和应力水平三个主导因素。本文适合从疲劳可靠性与可解释预测角度阅读，但当前仅有摘要，无法核实数据划分和工程适用边界。[摘要]

core.title: OperAItor: An Agentic Framework for Fault-Tolerant Operation of Chemical Processes
core.abstract: OperAItor, an open-source framework for developing and evaluating large language model agents for supervisory fault management in chemical processes. The framework is demonstrated on a dynamic reactor-distillation process representing isopropanol dehydrogenation, with physically based thermodynamics and modified reaction kinetics to permit liquid-phase operation. The process is represented by a 113-variable differential-algebraic model and operates at a nominal feed rate of 100kmol/h, producing approximately 4t/h of acetone. The simulated plant includes 8 PI control loops, 22 process alarms, 5 duty-standby pump trains, and 11 independent safety instrumented functions. The agent architecture integrates multivariate statistical process monitoring, fault diagnosis, knowledge-graph retrieval, action planning, and supervisory action generation. Five action-validation configurations are investigated, comprising operation without validation, an LLM-based judge, digital-twin simulation, and deterministic admissibility checks with and without consequence projection. The framework is evaluated using four LLMs across 20 scenarios involving single and multiple simultaneous faults. Without agent intervention, 18 scenarios result in plant stops, corresponding to an economic loss of $399,000 relative to fault-free operation under the assumed benchmark economics. For GPT-5 nano, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B, validated agent configurations reduce the number of stops to 5-8 and recover $265,000 of the loss. The study provides a reproducible benchmark for comparing agent architectures, language models, and action-validation methods for supervisory fault management in chemical processes.

core.title: A Review of Fault Diagnosis Technology for Rotating Machinery Based on Deep Generative Models
core.abstract: Fault diagnosis of rotating machinery frequently encounters the compounded challenges of non-stationary operating conditions and small-sample data constraints. Traditional deep learning models often exhibit suboptimal performance when addressing these issues. Deep Generative Models (DGMs) offer innovative solutions by synthesizing high-fidelity data samples, reconstructing latent system states, and modeling complex multimodal data streams. This paper presents a review of rotating machinery fault diagnosis technologies based on DGMs. The state-of-the-art applications of DGMs and their variants, including Deep Autoregressive Models (DARs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs), are systematically summarized. Specific applications discussed include data generation, domain adaptation and generalization, multimodal data fusion, as well as downstream fault diagnosis and anomaly detection. Furthermore, this review contrasts DGMs with traditional signal processing methods and standard deep learning models. Current limitations are also critically analyzed, focusing on parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies, interpretability (reliability), and computational efficiency for edge deployment. Finally, future research directions are proposed, emphasizing few-shot or zero-shot learning, robust multimodal data generation, physics-informed hybrid DGM architectures, and the integration of reinforcement learning with DGMs to further enhance diagnostic accuracy in practical scenarios.

core.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
core.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.
core.summary: 大语言模型接入专业诊断工具后，是否真的优于工具本身？本文在五个工业诊断数据集上考察这一问题，并用配对重复调用区分外部建议影响与输出不稳定性。四个具有直接集成比较的数据集均未显示隐式集成的稳定优势；确认集上，集成虽改善模型表现，却仍落后于专业工具。[摘要] 解读：论文值得智能运维研究者阅读，重点不是增强模型单体，而是检查集成层是否真正利用了不同来源的互补信息。

raw_metadata.recommendation: 推荐关注诊断工具与大语言模型协同的研究者重点阅读：摘要提供了直接对照、预先固定协议的确认集及敏感性分析，能帮助识别“优于裸模型”却不如专业工具的集成方案。[摘要]

deep_read.problem: 论文研究大语言模型作为专业工具上层时，能否可靠利用外部诊断信息，而非仅关注模型单体准确率。摘要指出，更强组件未必产生更强组合系统；五个数据集中，冲突信息均曾推翻模型原本正确的判断。[摘要] 解读：核心问题是信息整合能否保留正确判断并吸收有效纠错。
deep_read.method: 研究覆盖轴承振动、过程监控和半导体设备相关的五个诊断数据集，以“paired repeat calls”区分建议效应与输出不稳定性。四个数据集具有直接集成比较，另在评估前固定协议的Tennessee Eastman确认集上检验，并开展提示与专业工具敏感性分析。[摘要]
deep_read.innovation: 摘要未提供与既有工作的系统比较，不能确认首创性。可辨识的研究特色是分别评价来源质量和集成质量，并引入双来源选择器预言机作为互补潜力参照。[摘要] 解读：这种设计把信息源缺乏有效信息，与集成层未能利用已有信息区分开来。
deep_read.findings: 确认集上，未辅助模型、隐式集成和专业工具的准确率分别为64.67%、77.43%和83.33%；双来源选择器预言机达到92.76%。[摘要] 解读：外部信息提升了模型，却未使集成超过较强来源；预言机结果提示存在未被实际集成充分实现的互补空间，不代表可部署系统性能。
deep_read.limitations: 目前只有摘要，无法核对样本构造、提示全文、专业工具实现、选择器预言机的具体机制及统计区间计算方法。[摘要] 这些是当前资料的证据边界，并非已证实的实验缺陷。摘要结果也不足以判断显式路由或其他集成架构是否同样受限，不能泛化为所有协同方案无效。
deep_read.connection: 解读：该研究直接关联智能运维中的诊断决策可靠性，提醒系统评价不能只与未辅助模型比较。摘要要求集成层对照“stronger standalone component”。[摘要] 对可靠性研究，可借鉴其分别考察有效纠错与正确判断损失的思路；与结构设计的直接关联则缺少资料支持。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：后续阅读全文时优先核对配对调用、冲突信息构造和预言机定义，再研究显式来源选择能否缩小集成差距。实验宜同时报告相对较强单独组件的收益、有效纠错吸收率及正确判断损失率，并检验跨工况稳定性。这些是可迁移研究设想，不是作者已验证的结论。

core.title: Finite Element Method for Sustainable Structural Integrity of Multi-bolted Flanges: A Review of Optimized Design and Green Maintenance Strategies
core.abstract: Multi-bolted flange (MBF) connections are essential components of piping systems, pressure vessels, offshore structures, renewable energy infrastructure, and process plants. However, their long-term reliability is often affected by complex mechanical loading, thermal cycling, gasket degradation, corrosion, bolt preload loss, and uneven force distributions. These technical challenges can lead to leakage, fatigue failure, unplanned shutdowns, repeated component replacement, and increased material waste. This review examines the role of the Finite Element Method (FEM) in improving the sustainable structural integrity of MBF systems through optimised design and green maintenance strategies. Recent studies have been synthesised to show how FEM supports stress distribution analysis, bolt preload evaluation, gasket contact-pressure prediction, fatigue life assessment, leakage prevention, corrosion risk evaluation, and structural health monitoring. Particular attention is given to how FEM-driven modelling can reduce overdesign, improve sealing performance, extend service life, and support predictive maintenance by identifying critical failure mechanisms before field failure. This review also highlights the importance of bolt modelling conditions, including preload definition, contact interaction, gasket compressibility, frictional behaviour, mesh refinement, and service-induced load combinations. Although FEM has significantly advanced the understanding of MBF performance, important research gaps remain in the integration of FEM with self-healing materials, real-time adaptive control, sensor-based monitoring, machine learning validation, and digital twin maintenance frameworks. Overall, this review demonstrates that FEM provides a practical pathway for achieving safer, more reliable, and more resource-efficient MBF systems while supporting sustainable engineering and environmental protection.

papers.title: OperAItor: An Agentic Framework for Fault-Tolerant Operation of Chemical Processes
papers.abstract: OperAItor, an open-source framework for developing and evaluating large language model agents for supervisory fault management in chemical processes. The framework is demonstrated on a dynamic reactor-distillation process representing isopropanol dehydrogenation, with physically based thermodynamics and modified reaction kinetics to permit liquid-phase operation. The process is represented by a 113-variable differential-algebraic model and operates at a nominal feed rate of 100kmol/h, producing approximately 4t/h of acetone. The simulated plant includes 8 PI control loops, 22 process alarms, 5 duty-standby pump trains, and 11 independent safety instrumented functions. The agent architecture integrates multivariate statistical process monitoring, fault diagnosis, knowledge-graph retrieval, action planning, and supervisory action generation. Five action-validation configurations are investigated, comprising operation without validation, an LLM-based judge, digital-twin simulation, and deterministic admissibility checks with and without consequence projection. The framework is evaluated using four LLMs across 20 scenarios involving single and multiple simultaneous faults. Without agent intervention, 18 scenarios result in plant stops, corresponding to an economic loss of $399,000 relative to fault-free operation under the assumed benchmark economics. For GPT-5 nano, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B, validated agent configurations reduce the number of stops to 5-8 and recover $265,000 of the loss. The study provides a reproducible benchmark for comparing agent architectures, language models, and action-validation methods for supervisory fault management in chemical processes.

papers.title: A Review of Fault Diagnosis Technology for Rotating Machinery Based on Deep Generative Models
papers.abstract: Fault diagnosis of rotating machinery frequently encounters the compounded challenges of non-stationary operating conditions and small-sample data constraints. Traditional deep learning models often exhibit suboptimal performance when addressing these issues. Deep Generative Models (DGMs) offer innovative solutions by synthesizing high-fidelity data samples, reconstructing latent system states, and modeling complex multimodal data streams. This paper presents a review of rotating machinery fault diagnosis technologies based on DGMs. The state-of-the-art applications of DGMs and their variants, including Deep Autoregressive Models (DARs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs), are systematically summarized. Specific applications discussed include data generation, domain adaptation and generalization, multimodal data fusion, as well as downstream fault diagnosis and anomaly detection. Furthermore, this review contrasts DGMs with traditional signal processing methods and standard deep learning models. Current limitations are also critically analyzed, focusing on parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies, interpretability (reliability), and computational efficiency for edge deployment. Finally, future research directions are proposed, emphasizing few-shot or zero-shot learning, robust multimodal data generation, physics-informed hybrid DGM architectures, and the integration of reinforcement learning with DGMs to further enhance diagnostic accuracy in practical scenarios.

papers.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.
papers.summary: 大语言模型接入专业诊断工具后，是否真的优于工具本身？本文在五个工业诊断数据集上考察这一问题，并用配对重复调用区分外部建议影响与输出不稳定性。四个具有直接集成比较的数据集均未显示隐式集成的稳定优势；确认集上，集成虽改善模型表现，却仍落后于专业工具。[摘要] 解读：论文值得智能运维研究者阅读，重点不是增强模型单体，而是检查集成层是否真正利用了不同来源的互补信息。

deep_read.problem: 论文研究大语言模型作为专业工具上层时，能否可靠利用外部诊断信息，而非仅关注模型单体准确率。摘要指出，更强组件未必产生更强组合系统；五个数据集中，冲突信息均曾推翻模型原本正确的判断。[摘要] 解读：核心问题是信息整合能否保留正确判断并吸收有效纠错。
deep_read.method: 研究覆盖轴承振动、过程监控和半导体设备相关的五个诊断数据集，以“paired repeat calls”区分建议效应与输出不稳定性。四个数据集具有直接集成比较，另在评估前固定协议的Tennessee Eastman确认集上检验，并开展提示与专业工具敏感性分析。[摘要]
deep_read.innovation: 摘要未提供与既有工作的系统比较，不能确认首创性。可辨识的研究特色是分别评价来源质量和集成质量，并引入双来源选择器预言机作为互补潜力参照。[摘要] 解读：这种设计把信息源缺乏有效信息，与集成层未能利用已有信息区分开来。
deep_read.findings: 确认集上，未辅助模型、隐式集成和专业工具的准确率分别为64.67%、77.43%和83.33%；双来源选择器预言机达到92.76%。[摘要] 解读：外部信息提升了模型，却未使集成超过较强来源；预言机结果提示存在未被实际集成充分实现的互补空间，不代表可部署系统性能。
deep_read.limitations: 目前只有摘要，无法核对样本构造、提示全文、专业工具实现、选择器预言机的具体机制及统计区间计算方法。[摘要] 这些是当前资料的证据边界，并非已证实的实验缺陷。摘要结果也不足以判断显式路由或其他集成架构是否同样受限，不能泛化为所有协同方案无效。
deep_read.connection: 解读：该研究直接关联智能运维中的诊断决策可靠性，提醒系统评价不能只与未辅助模型比较。摘要要求集成层对照“stronger standalone component”。[摘要] 对可靠性研究，可借鉴其分别考察有效纠错与正确判断损失的思路；与结构设计的直接关联则缺少资料支持。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：后续阅读全文时优先核对配对调用、冲突信息构造和预言机定义，再研究显式来源选择能否缩小集成差距。实验宜同时报告相对较强单独组件的收益、有效纠错吸收率及正确判断损失率，并检验跨工况稳定性。这些是可迁移研究设想，不是作者已验证的结论。

papers.title: Finite Element Method for Sustainable Structural Integrity of Multi-bolted Flanges: A Review of Optimized Design and Green Maintenance Strategies
papers.abstract: Multi-bolted flange (MBF) connections are essential components of piping systems, pressure vessels, offshore structures, renewable energy infrastructure, and process plants. However, their long-term reliability is often affected by complex mechanical loading, thermal cycling, gasket degradation, corrosion, bolt preload loss, and uneven force distributions. These technical challenges can lead to leakage, fatigue failure, unplanned shutdowns, repeated component replacement, and increased material waste. This review examines the role of the Finite Element Method (FEM) in improving the sustainable structural integrity of MBF systems through optimised design and green maintenance strategies. Recent studies have been synthesised to show how FEM supports stress distribution analysis, bolt preload evaluation, gasket contact-pressure prediction, fatigue life assessment, leakage prevention, corrosion risk evaluation, and structural health monitoring. Particular attention is given to how FEM-driven modelling can reduce overdesign, improve sealing performance, extend service life, and support predictive maintenance by identifying critical failure mechanisms before field failure. This review also highlights the importance of bolt modelling conditions, including preload definition, contact interaction, gasket compressibility, frictional behaviour, mesh refinement, and service-induced load combinations. Although FEM has significantly advanced the understanding of MBF performance, important research gaps remain in the integration of FEM with self-healing materials, real-time adaptive control, sensor-based monitoring, machine learning validation, and digital twin maintenance frameworks. Overall, this review demonstrates that FEM provides a practical pathway for achieving safer, more reliable, and more resource-efficient MBF systems while supporting sustainable engineering and environmental protection.
